tip

Combustion · 1m (reduced by 60s via Kindling) · +100% spell crit chance for 10s, usable while casting other spells. Line it up with big pulls and boss burst windows, and press it just before another cast finishes (Wowhead)
tip
Meteor · 45s · Lands after 3s for AoE fire damage and a 4s ground patch. Use it with Combustion
tip
Hot Streak!: 2 crits in a row make your next Pyroblast or Flamestrike instant. Use Pyroblast when there's a priority target, Flamestrike when there are lots of adds (Icy Veins)
tip
Time Warp · 5m · Party haste +30% for 40s. Coordinate timing with your party
tb
Blazing Barrier · 30s · Shield absorbing 30% of max health for 1m. Keep it up on cooldown and reapply right before big AoE damage. Applying it clears all snares via Energized Barriers
tb
Ice Block · 3m 30s (Winter's Protection) · With Ice Cold, taken in both M+ builds, you take 70% less damage for 6s instead of immunity and keep DPSing while moving
tb

Alter Time · 1m · After 10s (or on a second press), returns you to your original position and health. Press it right before a big hit and return after taking it. Returning resets Shimmer's cooldown via Time Walk
tb
Cauterize: lethal damage leaves you at 35% health and burning for 6s (passive). Arcane Warding reduces magic damage taken by 4%
int
Counterspell · 25s · 40-meter interrupt, locks the school for 7s. Long cooldown, so take only one slot in the interrupt rotation
cc
Supernova · 45s · Knocks up enemies within 8 meters of the target, interrupting casts. It doesn't stop them from recasting. Bosses are immune
cc
Frost Nova · 30s · Roots enemies within 12 meters for 6s. For kiting adds and slowing chasing adds. Polymorph incapacitates one target for 1m (bosses immune)
disp
Remove Curse · 8s · Removes curses from an ally. Spellsteal takes a beneficial magic effect from an enemy
tip
Greater Invisibility · 2m · 20s invisibility, resets threat. Use it to break casts and channels aimed at you: Boneslicer, Bloodthorn Roots, Void Cascade, Gust (Wowhead)
tip
Mirror Image · 2m · 3 images, generate less threat. Pressing Alter Time twice stops you sliding on ice (Wowhead)
pos
Mobility: Shimmer (30s, 20-meter teleport, usable while casting); Sunfury DPSes on the move with Scorch
tip
Before combat, cast Arcane Intellect (party Intellect +3%)
int

disp

sunfury.title: Sunfury Key Points
items: Summon the Arcane Phoenix with {Combustion} and use {Meteor} alongside it, lined up with big pulls and boss burst windows
When {Spellfire Spheres} are generated, use your next {Fire Blast} on stacked enemies to drop Meteorites

frostfire.title: Frostfire Key Points
items: Line up {Combustion} and {Meteor} with big pulls, and use the {Frostfire Empowerment} from {Flash Freezeburn} right away
Slow chasing adds with the {Frostfire Bolt} snare and {Frost Nova}

Rav'i: [광역 피해] Line up Combustion (1 min with Kindling) and Meteor (45 sec) on the Ssscavenging shield to break it fast
[광역 피해] Recast Blazing Barrier right before Ravenous Stomp (145474 Nature to everyone)
[참고] If Regurgitate slows you, recast Blazing Barrier to clear the slow with Energized Barriers
The Writhing Coil: [차단] Put Counterspell (25 sec) into the Toxic Atrophy three-kick rotation once
[광역 피해] Bloodlust goes out when Uncoil splits the boss into five Writhes (Topicx). If nobody else has lust, pop Time Warp and cleave the Writhes together with Combustion, Meteor and Flamestrike
[제어] Root Writhes heading for the Spiteful Hunt target with Frost Nova
Zul'jan: [위치] If your Ritual of the Fang beam spot is far, Shimmer there before the channel starts and put up Blazing Barrier before soaking the beam. If your health is low, press Ice Block with Ice Cold

[회피] Shimmer away from the Axegrinder spinning axes. When you deliberately brush a slowed axe to clear Ritual Venom, it deals armor-ignoring Physical damage, so recast Blazing Barrier first (Topicx·Icy Veins)
[참고] Greater Invisibility on a Boneslicer target makes the boss skip that cast (Wowhead). Do not use it while party members still need to clear Ritual Venom

Lightblossom Trinity: [차단] Kezkitt's Light Bolt (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Holy) does not need a set kick rotation. Stop it with Counterspell (25 sec) when it is available
[광역 피해] The three bosses stand together, so cleave them with Flamestrike and Meteor
[위치] When you stand in Fertile Loam (50% slow, 77586 Nature every 1 sec) to block Lightblossom Beam, Shimmer (20 yd) out of the patch as soon as the beam ends
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: [광역 피해] Refresh Blazing Barrier right before the 6 sec Thorncaller Roar AoE (82435 Nature), and add Ice Block (70% less damage taken for 6 sec with Ice Cold) for the Roar during Lightcrazed Frenzy after 50%

[참고] Bloodlust goes out below 50% when no Bloodthirsty Gaze chase is active (Topicx). If nobody else has lust, pop Time Warp with Combustion then, and if you are the Gaze target, make distance with Shimmer while Sunfury keeps casting with Scorch
[해제] If Bloodthorn Roots grabs you, break it with Greater Invisibility (Wowhead)
Lightwarden Ruia: [차단] Warden's Wrath (2 sec cast, 48491 Nature), repeated on the tank in Moonkin Form, does not need a set kick rotation. Counterspell (25 sec) it whenever it is back to cut the tank's magic damage

[위치] If you are marked for Pulverizing Strikes with Grievous Thrash bleed still up, pop Alter Time (1 min) beforehand and press it again after the cones (164870 Physical every 2 sec for 6 sec) end to restore your health
[광역 피해] Save Ice Block (Ice Cold) for Spirits of the Vale after 40%
Ziekket: [차단] Counterspell the Lashers' Lightspore Shot before they revive, and knock up stacked Lashers with Supernova to stop their casts together
[광역 피해] When the Lashers spawn, the tank holds them in the middle of the pack, so drop Flamestrike there and spread Ignite with Fire Blast (Ignition)
[위치] Do not Shimmer (20 yd) back to the far right edge of the platform. Going all the way to the right edge pulls Overgrown Hydra (Topicx)

The Hoardmonger: [광역 피해] Apply Blazing Barrier right before the Ravenous Bellow physical AoE
[위치] If your assigned Spoiled Supplies mushroom is far, Shimmer to it within 12s
Sentinel of Winter: [차단] Put Counterspell into the Fractured Shivercore Winter's Shroud kick rotation

[우선 처치] As ranged, you take the Fractured Shivercore away from the boss (Topicx). Do not melt your add alone with Combustion; watch the tank-side add's health and time Combustion and Meteor so both adds die together
[위치] Shimmer into a Snowdrift before Frozen Tempest. Do not Shimmer toward the snow and ice at the room's edge, and if you slide on the ice, double-tap Alter Time to stop (Wowhead)
Nalorakk: [광역 피해] Put up Blazing Barrier before blocking Echoes during Fury of the War God, and press Ice Block if Echoes overlap
[위치] If you are targeted by Echoing Maul, recast Blazing Barrier or pop Alter Time, then Shimmer to this set's assigned corner within 4 sec (Topicx)

Kystia Manaheart: [우선 처치] Line up Combustion and Meteor with the 20s Destabilized window, spend Hot Streak on Pyroblast and hit Kystia
[차단] Interrupt one Mirror Images clone with Counterspell, and knock up stacked clones together with Supernova
Zaen Bladesorrow: [광역 피해] The second lust goes out as the boss engages (Topicx). If nobody else has lust, pop Time Warp and cleave the dragged-in Warehouse Worker pack with Combustion, Meteor and Flamestrike. Root fleeing Workers with Frost Nova
[광역 피해] Put up Blazing Barrier right before the Killing Spree AoE
[위치] During Murder in a Row, if the nearest barrel is far, Shimmer behind it before the cast ends. Several players can hide behind one barrel (Topicx)
Xathuux the Annihilator: [우선 처치] Line up Combustion and Meteor with Demonic Rage, when the boss takes 30% more damage. The third lust goes on the second Demonic Rage (Topicx), so if nobody else has lust, pop Time Warp then
[광역 피해] Press Ice Block during Infernal Crush if the axe is still up
Lithiel Cinderfury: [차단] Put Counterspell into the Chaos Bolt kick rotation

[제어] When Wild Imps gather, stop their Felfire Burst together with Supernova. Line up Combustion and Meteor when Furious Vilefiend and Wild Imps spawn (Topicx), and kill the adds first with Flamestrike
[회피] You can Shimmer over Malefic Wave (Wowhead)

Taz'Rah: [광역 피해] Apply Blazing Barrier right before the Dark Bloom party-wide shadow damage
[회피] When Void Fissure orbs swarm in, Shimmer out
Atroxus: [우선 처치] Bloodlust goes out when the first Toxic Creeper spawns (Topicx). If nobody else has lust, pop Time Warp with Combustion then and spend Hot Streak! on Pyroblast into the Creeper to kill it fast
[광역 피해] Put up Blazing Barrier right before the Monstrous Roar physical AoE
Charonus: [위치] If Gravitic Orbs targets you, as ranged you drag the orb to the far Unstable Singularity (Topicx). Recast Blazing Barrier to clear the Condensed Mass slow with Energized Barriers and close the distance with Shimmer
[광역 피해] Press Ice Block for the 20 sec Cosmic Crash DoT
[회피] If you are targeted by Void Cascade, stop the cast with Greater Invisibility (Wowhead)

The Golden Serpent: [제어] When Lucre's Call spawns Animated Gold, root them with Frost Nova to delay them reaching the boss and kill them together with Flamestrike
[광역 피해] Apply Blazing Barrier right before the Serpentine Gust AoE
Mchimba the Embalmer: [차단] Put Counterspell in the kick rotation for Half-Finished Mummy's and Finished Mummy's Wretched Discharge, and stop two stacked mummies together with Supernova
[위치] During Entomb, Shimmer quickly to the shaking sarcophagus
[광역 피해] Bloodlust goes on this boss (Topicx). If nobody else has lust, pop Time Warp at the start with Combustion and Meteor, and refresh Blazing Barrier right before Awakening Slam's group damage
The Council of Tribes: [우선 처치] The longer Kula lives, the more Whirling Axes pile up, so line up Combustion and Meteor on Kula and kill her before the fourth set of axes (Topicx)
[차단] Put Counterspell in the kick rotation for Zanazal's Poison Nova
[우선 처치] Spend Hot Streak! on Pyroblast to break the Explosive Totem before Explode
Dazar, The First King: [우선 처치] Bloodlust goes at the start of Dazar (Topicx). If nobody else has lust, pop Time Warp, and line up Combustion and Meteor on Reban to kill him before 80%
[차단] Put Counterspell in the kick rotation for Reban's Deathly Roar
[광역 피해] Stack Blazing Barrier and Ice Block (Ice Cold) for Gilded Destruction's 15 sec group DoT

Melidrussa Chillworn: [차단] The tank interrupts Frigid Shard right after the Hailburst ice lands (Topicx). Counterspell it for them only when the tank's interrupt is not back
[우선 처치] Line up Combustion and Meteor on the intermission Ice Bulwark to break it fast
[광역 피해] Frost Overload during the intermission is the heaviest group damage, so refresh Blazing Barrier, and press Ice Block (Ice Cold) when the damage-taken stacks get high (Topicx)
Kokia Blazehoof: [차단] Take a slot in Blazebound Firestorm's Blaze Volley rotation with Counterspell
[우선 처치] When the Blazebound Firestorm spawns, switch to it immediately and spend Hot Streak on Pyroblast
Kyrakka & Erkhart Stormvein: [참고] Near the end of Interrupting Cloudburst, use only Fire Blast, Phoenix Flames and instant Pyroblasts from Hot Streak to avoid the lockout
[우선 처치] Line up Combustion and Meteor at the start of phase 2, and once they merge, focus the lower-health boss to finish it first (Topicx)
[광역 피해] If Inferno Spit targets you, refresh Blazing Barrier near the end of the 6 sec DoT when the circle explodes, and add Ice Block (Ice Cold) in phase 2 (Topicx)

Adderis & Aspix: [위치] After the Gale Force knockback, Shimmer straight back to your Thunder and Lightning soak spot
[제어] If targeted by Aspix's Gust, break the cast with Greater Invisibility (Wowhead)
Merektha: [차단] Put Counterspell in the kick rotation for Toxic Viper's Poison Spit
[광역 피해] Kill the Hatch adds together with Flamestrike and Meteor after the tank grabs the Storm Serpent first (Topicx)
[광역 피해] Refresh Blazing Barrier right before Serpentstorm's group damage, and if A Knot of Snakes targets you, break out with Shimmer (Wowhead says Blink frees you)
Galvazzt: [위치] On your beam-soaking turn, apply Blazing Barrier; if Galvanized stacks get high, use Ice Block
Avatar of Sethraliss: [우선 처치] Line up Combustion on the Essence Defiler and spend Hot Streak on Pyroblast
[차단] Take a slot in the Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock rotation with Counterspell
[제어] Root Faithless Tormentors chasing the healer with Frost Nova and kill them with Flamestrike

133.m: 1% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 1.75 초 주문 시전 시간

475.m: 특성 · 1.3% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 8 초 재사용 대기시간

1459.d:

2120.m: 특성 · 1.5% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 3.5 초 주문 시전 시간
2120.d:
불기둥을 불러 일으켜 대상 지역 내의 모든 적에게 (주문력의 345%)의 화염 피해를 입힙니다. 8명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

2139.m: 2% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 25 초 재사용 대기시간
2139.d: 적의 주문 시전을 차단하여, 7초 동안 같은 계열의 주문을 시전하지 못하게 만듭니다.

2948.m: 특성 · 1% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 1.5 초 주문 시전 시간
2948.d:
적을 불태워 (주문력의 100%)의 화염 피해를 입힙니다.

생명력이 30% 미만으로 떨어진 대상에게 시전 시 불태우기가 항상 치명타 및 극대화 효과를 발휘합니다.

이동하면서 시전할 수 있습니다.

11366.m: 특성 · 1.5% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 4 초 주문 시전 시간
11366.d: 엄청난 크기의 불덩이를 던져 (주문력의 638.8%)의 화염 피해를 입힙니다.

12846.d: 화염구, 화염 작렬, 불덩이 작렬 [유성: 유성], 불기둥으로 피해를 입히면 추가로 9초 동안 대상을 불태워 직접 피해량의 4.0%에 해당하는 추가 피해를 입힙니다. 다시 적용되면 남아 있던 피해량이 새로운 작열 효과에 추가됩니다.

30449.m: 특성 · 21% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시
30449.d: 대상으로부터 [도벽: 이로운 마법 효과를 모두 훔칩니다. 이 효과는 최대 2분 동안 지속됩니다 / 이로운 마법 효과 하나를 훔칩니다. 이 효과는 최대 2분 동안 지속됩니다.]

45438.m: 특성 · 즉시 · 4 분 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
45438.d:
커다란 얼음 덩어리에 둘러싸여 10초 동안 모든 공격과 피해로부터 보호받습니다. 하지만 이 동안은 공격하거나 이동하거나 마법을 사용하지 못합니다.

저체온증을 유발하여, 30초 동안은 얼음 방패를 다시 시전하지 못합니다.

48107.d: 주문 극대화 효과를 발휘했습니다. 연속으로 한 번 더 주문 극대화 효과를 발휘하면, 다음 불덩이 작렬 또는 불기둥 주문은 즉시 시전되며, 일반 작열의 두 배에 해당하는 피해를 입힙니다.

48108.d: 화염 주문으로 2회 연속 직접 피해가 치명타 및 극대화 효과를 발휘하면 다음 불덩이 작렬 또는 불기둥이 즉시 시전되고 100%만큼 추가 작열 피해를 부여합니다.

55342.m: 특성 · 2% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
55342.d:
15초 동안 자신의 복제 3개를 주위에 생성합니다. 이 복제는 주문을 시전하고 적을 공격합니다. 활성화된 동안 생성하는 위협 수준이 크게 감소합니다.

직접 피해를 받으면 환영 하나가 사라집니다. (2초 재사용 대기시간)

80353.m: 4% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 5 분 재사용 대기시간
80353.d:
시간의 흐름을 왜곡하여, 40초 동안 모든 파티원과 공격대원의 가속을 30%만큼 증가시킵니다.

아군은 10분 동안 피의 욕망, 영웅심, 시간 왜곡 효과를 받지 못합니다.

86949.d:
죽음에 달하는 피해를 입을 시, 죽지 않고 최대 생명력의 35%를 회복한 후 6초에 걸쳐 불타오르며 최대 생명력의 28%를 잃습니다.

불타오르는 동안에는 감속 효과의 영향을 받지 않고 이동 속도가 150%만큼 증가합니다.

이 효과는 6분에 1번씩만 발동됩니다.

108853.m: 특성 · 1% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 14 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
108853.d:
적을 불태워 치명타 및 극대화 효과를 발휘해 [(주문력의 98.625%) * 2]의 화염 피해를 입힙니다.

다른 주문 시전 중에도 시전할 수 있습니다.

110959.d: 즉시 투명 상태로 변해 20초 동안 적의 대상이 되지 않고 위협 수준을 모두 제거합니다. 어떤 행동이든 취하면 효과가 취소됩니다.

153561.m: 특성 · 1% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 45 초 재사용 대기시간
153561.d:
3초 후에 유성을 목표 위치로 떨어뜨려, 모든 적에게 (주문력의 900%)의 화염 피해를 입힙니다. 또한 땅을 불태워 그 안에 있는 모든 적에게 4초에 걸쳐 [8 * (주문력의 104%)]의 화염 피해를 입힙니다.

8명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

157980.m: 특성 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 45 초 재사용 대기시간
157980.d: 대상 적이나 아군 주위에 비전 마력의 파동을 만들어, 8미터 내의 모든 적에게 (주문력의 34.5%)의 비전 피해를 입히고 공중에 띄웁니다. 주 적 대상은 입는 피해가 100%만큼 증가합니다.

190319.m: 특성 · 10% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
190319.d:
10초 동안 불길에 휘감겨 주문의 치명타 및 극대화율이 100%만큼 증가합니다.
[
추가로 자신의 주문 공격력이 0%만큼 증가합니다.]

다른 주문 시전 중에도 시전할 수 있습니다.

Additionally, increases your Mastery by 75% of your critical strike chance.

205026.d: 생명력이 90%를 초과하는 대상에게는 화염구 및 불덩이 작렬이 항상 극대화 효과를 발휘합니다.

212653.m: 특성 · 점멸을(를) 대신함 · 2% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
212653.d: 장애물이 없는 한 20미터 전방으로 순간이동합니다. 전역 재사용 대기시간의 영향을 받지 않고, 다른 주문을 시전하는 중에도 시전할 수 있습니다.

235313.m: 특성 · 3% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
235313.d:
1분 동안 자신에게 불꽃의 보호막을 씌워 [30 / 100 * 총 생명력 * (1 + 유연성)]의 피해를 흡수 [작열의 갑옷: 하고, 받는 물리 피해를 0%만큼 감소시킵니다 / 합니다.]

근접 공격에 적중당하면 공격자에게 (주문력의 14.375%)의 화염 피해를 입힙니다.

257541.m: 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 25 초 재사용 대기시간 · 2회 사용 가능
257541.d: 불사조를 날려 대상에게 (주문력의 77%)의 화염 피해를 입히고 주위의 다른 적에게 감소된 화염 피해를 입힙니다.

269650.d:
몰아치는 열기를 소모하면 15%의 확률로 다음 20초 안에 시전하는 즉시 시전이 아닌 불덩이 작렬 또는 불기둥이 230%의 추가 피해를 입힙니다.

최대 2번까지 중첩됩니다.

342245.m: 특성 · 1% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 1 분 재사용 대기시간
342245.d: 시간의 결을 조작하여, 첫 번째 시전할 때의 장소와 체력 상태로 두 번째 시전 시 혹은 10초 후에 돌아오게 합니다. 너무 먼 거리를 이동하거나 죽으면 효과가 취소됩니다.

342344.d:
화염 작렬의 공격력이 15%만큼 증가합니다.

직접 공격 주문 시전 시 화염 작렬의 재사용 대기시간이 0.50초만큼 감소합니다. (100밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

383810.d: 연속으로 극대화 공격을 할 때마다 극대화 피해가 1%만큼, 최대 4%만큼 증가합니다. 6초 동안 지속됩니다.

386828.d: 방벽 시전 시 모든 감속 효과에서 벗어납니다.

414659.d: 얼음 방패 시전 시 6초 동안 받는 모든 피해가 70%만큼 감소하지만 더는 면역 상태가 되지도, 이동, 공격, 주문 시전을 방지하지도 않습니다. 전역 재사용 대기시간을 발동시키지 않습니다.

431044.m: 특성 · 2% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 1.75 초 주문 시전 시간
431044.d: 적에게 얼음불꽃 화살을 발사하여 (주문력의 259.4%)의 냉기화염 피해를 입히고 이동 속도를 50%만큼 감소시킵니다. 추가로 8초에 걸쳐 (주문력의 21.6%)의 추가 냉기화염 피해를 입힙니다.

431066.d: 이글거리는 방벽 시전 시 추가로 25%의 효율로 얼음 보호막을 시전합니다.

431176.d: 서리불꽃 주문 시전 시 10%의 확률로 서리불꽃 강화가 활성화되어 다음 얼음불꽃 화살이 즉시 시전되며 60%의 추가 피해를 입히고, 적중 시 폭발하여 주위의 적에게 입힌 피해의 60%에 해당하는 피해를 입힙니다. 5명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

431178.d:
유성의 공격력이 25%만큼 증가합니다.

유성이 서리불꽃 강화를 부여합니다.

448601.d:
몰아치는 열기 효과 소모 시 12%의 확률로 비전화염 구슬을 생성합니다.

전투 중이 아닐 때 서서히 비전화염 구슬을 생성합니다.

비전화염 구슬
주문 공격력이 1.0%만큼 증가합니다. 최대 3번까지 중첩됩니다.

448658.d:
발화 시전 시 비전 불사조를 소환하여 전투를 돕게 합니다.

비전 불사조
비전 불사조는 발화의 지속시간 동안 전투를 도우며, 무작위 비전 및 화염 주문을 시전합니다.

449349.d: 화염 파열의 공격력 증가량이 20%만큼 증가하고, 특성으로 선택했을 경우 유성이 화염 파열을 부여합니다.

449394.d:
비전화염 구슬 생성 시 다음에 시전하는 화염 작렬이 대상에게 유성 파편 4개를 불러 내립니다.

유성 파편
3초 후에 유성 파편을 목표 위치로 떨어뜨려 적중당한 모든 적에게 (주문력의 102%)의 화염 피해를 나누어 입힙니다. 8명을 넘어가는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

449619.d:
비전 불사조가 만료되면 시전자가 강화되어 4.0초 동안 이상 고열이 부여됩니다.

이상 고열:
불덩이 작렬 및 불기둥의 시전 시간이 없어짐
불덩이 작렬 및 불기둥이 항상 극대화 효과 발휘
불덩이 작렬 및 불기둥의 공격력 15%만큼 증가

453282.d: 불덩이 작렬과 불기둥의 시전 시간이 20%만큼 감소합니다.

1244087.d: 원래 위치로 돌아오면 시간 돌리기가 점멸 및 일렁임의 재사용 대기시간을 초기화합니다.

1246030.d: 발화 시전 후 다음 점멸을 시전하면 이전 위치에 화염 폭풍을 방출하여 적에게 (주문력의 54.3375%)의 화염 피해를 입히고, 8미터 뒤로 밀쳐내며, 6초 동안 이동 속도를 70%만큼 감소시킵니다.

1254756.d:
화염 작렬 시전 시 대상에게 부여된 작열 효과의 50%를 적 1명에게 퍼뜨립니다.

불기둥이 작열을 15%만큼 추가로 부여합니다.

1271177.d: 발화가 만료되면 활성화된 모든 작열이 폭발해 남은 피해의 75%에 해당하는 피해를 입힙니다.

1: [차단] Put Counterspell (25 sec) in the kick rotation for Radiant Spellsower's Light Bolt Volley (4 sec cast, 174568 Holy to the whole party).

[제어] If a Spellsower runs to a dormant Lasher pack with Call The Grove, catch up with Shimmer (30 sec, 20 yd) and root it for 6 sec with Frost Nova (30 sec). Frostfire builds can also slow it by 50% with Frostfire Bolt.

[광역 피해] Bloodlust goes out once everything is stacked (Topicx). If nobody else has lust, pop Time Warp (5 min, 30% party haste for 40 sec) and line up Combustion (1 min with Kindling) and Meteor (45 sec) with it. Refresh Blazing Barrier (30 sec) right before Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret (87284 Holy every 2 sec for 6 sec).
2: [차단] When both Radiant Spellsowers cast Light Bolt Volley, Counterspell one and stop the other next to the tank with Supernova (45 sec, 8 yd knock-up).
[우선 처치] This pull has few mobs, so spend Hot Streak! on Pyroblast instead of Flamestrike and kill the Spellsowers first (Icy Veins). Refresh Blazing Barrier right before Spouting Floret.
3: [광역 피해] This pull stacks 12 Lashers, so spend Hot Streak! on Flamestrike, and if Combustion (1 min) and Meteor (45 sec) from pull 1 are back, use them here.
[차단] If both Radiant Spellsowers cast Light Bolt Volley while stacked on the tank, knock both up with Supernova and save Counterspell for the next cast.

[우선 처치] A Lightgorged Lasher shielded by Lightbloom Pollination (600108 absorb) is immune to crowd control, so Supernova and Frost Nova will not land on it. Break the shield first with Pyroblast and Fire Blast.
5: [차단] Counterspell Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech (4 sec cast, 3 sec party disorient).

[제어] When Thorny Saptor jumps in with Thornclaw Leap and swings its frontal cone (193965 Physical plus knockback every 2 sec for 6 sec), knock it up with Supernova to stop the attacks. Neither M+ build has a stun, so Supernova is your only AoE stop.

[광역 피해] Sporeblight Belcher is pulled first and Virid Grovekeeper joins 5-6 sec later, so hold Combustion and Meteor until the Grovekeeper is stacked too. Refresh Blazing Barrier for the Belcher's Spouting Floret.
7: [차단] Counterspell Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech. Stop Leafy Grovecrawler's Seed Shot (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Nature) only when Counterspell is spare.
[회피] Dodge the two Luminous Thornmaws' Solar Breath (3 sec cast, 387930 Holy) by leaving the cone with Shimmer, which works while casting. Stop the two Thorny Saptors' Thornclaw Leap with Supernova.

[참고] The five Spineshield Beetles' Spiny Shield (500090 absorb, 4849 Nature reflected per hit) can be stolen with Spellsteal (Wowhead). Each Spellsteal costs 21% of base mana, so steal only a few before breaking the rest with Flamestrike.
8: [제어] Stop the two Thorny Saptors' Thornclaw Leap with Supernova (45 sec). If you used it in pull 7 and it is not back, Shimmer out of the cone.
[차단] Counterspell one of the two Leafy Grovecrawlers' Seed Shot.
[광역 피해] Refresh Blazing Barrier right before Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret, and steal the Spineshield Beetles' Spiny Shield with Spellsteal as in pull 7.
10: [위치] Potatoad Matriarch is pulled as soon as you cross a certain spot on the floor (Topicx), so do not Shimmer forward while the Lashers are being cleared.

[광역 피해] Fire Mage cannot dispel Toxic Spew (2 sec cast, 67888 Nature, then a poison dealing 58189 Nature every 1.5 sec for 9 sec). When you see the cast, refresh Blazing Barrier to absorb the poison damage.
[우선 처치] Line up Combustion and Meteor as you engage the Matriarch (60 count), and when a Potadpole Egg appears, spend Hot Streak! on a Pyroblast into the Egg to break it quickly.
11: [차단] One Counterspell cannot stop all three Lightfeather Petalwings' Disorienting Screech. Counterspell one and stop the rest stacked on the tank with Supernova.
[회피] Shimmer out of Luminous Thornmaw's Solar Breath cone, and refresh Blazing Barrier right before Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret.
12: [광역 피해] This is the last big pull, with six Lightgorged Lashers and six Lashers, so line up Combustion and Meteor here and spend Hot Streak! on Flamestrike. Refresh Blazing Barrier right before Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret.
[차단] Split the two Radiant Spellsowers' Light Bolt Volley between Counterspell and Supernova. Shielded Lightgorged Lashers are immune to crowd control, so aim Supernova at a Spellsower.
[제어] If a Spellsower runs away with Call The Grove, catch up with Shimmer and root it for 6 sec with Frost Nova.

1: [차단] Take one of the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss (4 sec cast, 135775 armor-ignoring Physical, 30% haste reduction) with Counterspell (25 sec).

[광역 피해] When Twinfang Harrower's Paralyzing Shots (48491 Nature every sec for 20 sec, 10% slow per tick) slows you, recast Blazing Barrier (30 sec). Energized Barriers clears every snare and the shield absorbs the DoT (Wowhead rates Energized Barriers as Need in this dungeon).

[회피] Dodge the Toxic Breath frontal (3 sec cast, 67888 Nature every 0.5 sec) by Shimmering to the Harrower's side, which works while casting. Eight Venom Leeches and seven Ravenous Descendants stack here, so spend Hot Streak! on Flamestrike.
2: [우선 처치] This small pull is a good cooldown pull (Topicx). Line up Combustion (1 min with Kindling) and Meteor (45 sec) on the Ritual Chieftain and spend Hot Streak! on Pyroblast into the Chieftain.
[광역 피해] Blood Sacrifice (87284 Physical to the whole party, 162029 heal absorb) can be avoided by hiding out of line of sight (Wowhead). If you cannot hide, recast Blazing Barrier right before it.
[차단] Kick the Primal Serpent's Piercing Hiss with Counterspell.
3: [차단] When the three Primal Serpents walk down while you wait behind the pillar, Counterspell one and stop the other two's Piercing Hiss, stacked on the tank, with Supernova (45 sec, 8 yd knock-up).

[우선 처치] This is another cooldown pull (Topicx). If Combustion (1 min) and Meteor (45 sec) from pull 2 are back, line them up on the Ritual Chieftain, and recast Blazing Barrier right before Blood Sacrifice.
4: [우선 처치] Spend Hot Streak! on Pyroblast into the Ritual Chieftain to kill it before several Blood Sacrifices land. Take one Primal Serpent's Piercing Hiss with Counterspell.
5: [광역 피해] This is the biggest pull at 103 trash. Press Combustion and Meteor together, but spend Hot Streak! on Pyroblast into the Ritual Chieftain until it dies, then switch to Flamestrike.

[광역 피해] Clear the two Twinfang Harrowers' Paralyzing Shots slows with Blazing Barrier (Energized Barriers). If Blood Sacrifice and the Paralyzing Shots DoTs overlap and drop you low, press Ice Block. With Ice Cold it reduces damage taken by 70% for 6 sec and you keep moving and casting.
[차단] Counterspell one of the two Primal Serpents and Shimmer out of the Toxic Breath frontal.
7: [차단] Counterspell High Evolutionist's Mass Envenom (3.5 sec cast, 58189 Nature plus 24246 Nature every sec for 8 sec), and break Evolve (6 sec channel) with Supernova's knock-up.
[참고] The shield gained when Evolve completes (250045 absorb, crowd-control immunity) is a magic effect, so Spellsteal can steal it away.
[광역 피해] Recast Blazing Barrier right before Rattling Writhe's Rattle (58189 armor-ignoring Physical every sec for 5 sec).
8: [제어] Neither M+ build has a stun. When the four Bloodletters stack on the tank, knock them all up with Supernova to briefly stop their melee swings and blood pools.
[광역 피해] Recast Blazing Barrier right before Rattle. If the Combustion (1 min) used on pull 7 is back, use it here with Flamestrike.
9: [차단] Take the High Evolutionist that tends to be left alone far to the left (Topicx). Kicking its Mass Envenom with 40 yd Counterspell locks that school for 7 sec, so it walks into the pack.
[우선 처치] Spend Hot Streak! on Pyroblast into the two High Evolutionists to kill them before the second Mass Envenom, and break Evolve with Supernova. Recast Blazing Barrier right before Rattle.
11: [차단] Assign one kicker to each of the four High Evolutionists (Topicx). Counterspell your Evolutionist's Mass Envenom, and when several channel Evolve together next to the tank, knock them all up with Supernova.
[참고] Spellsteal the shield off any Evolutionist that finished Evolve. Each Spellsteal costs 21% of base mana, so use it only on the one or two that got the shield.
12: [우선 처치] Ascendant Serpent must die before the third Infest, so line up Combustion and Meteor on this mini-boss and spend Hot Streak! on Pyroblast.

[광역 피해] When Infest hits you (34914 Nature every sec for 5 sec, then 69827 Nature within 8 yd), recast Blazing Barrier to absorb it. Shimmer out of Virulent Whirl impact spots (290947 Nature within 6 yd).
13: [우선 처치] Spend Hot Streak! on Pyroblast into Ula'tek's Chosen and kill it first. The six Living Venoms endanger the party if they all burst at once, so do not pour Flamestrike into the Venoms during Combustion (Topicx).
[차단] Chosen's Mass Envenom must be kicked every time, so save Counterspell (25 sec) for the Chosen.
[광역 피해] When you see the Toxic Surge cast (2 sec cast, 29095 Nature every sec for 9 sec), recast Blazing Barrier, and Shimmer out of the following Toxic Beam lines (339438 Nature).
14: [광역 피해] This is the second Chosen in a row. If the Blazing Barrier (30 sec) used on pull 13 is not back, press Ice Block (Ice Cold, 70% damage reduction for 6 sec) for Toxic Surge.
[우선 처치] Focus Pyroblast on the Chosen and kick Mass Envenom with Counterspell.
15: [차단] Take one of the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss with Counterspell.
[광역 피해] Clear the Paralyzing Shots slow with Blazing Barrier (Energized Barriers) and Shimmer out of the Toxic Breath frontal.
16: [우선 처치] Line up Combustion and Meteor on Ula'tek's Chosen and spend Hot Streak! on Pyroblast into it to kill it before the second Toxic Surge. Kick the Chosen's Mass Envenom with Counterspell.

[광역 피해] The two Ritual Chieftains' Blood Sacrifices come back to back. Take the first with Blazing Barrier and press Ice Block (Ice Cold) for the second, which overlaps Toxic Surge. If you can hide out of line of sight, avoid Blood Sacrifice that way (Wowhead).

1: [광역 피해] This lust pull grabs Bribed Captain and Bribed Guard together (Topicx). If nobody else has lust, pop Time Warp (5 min) and line up Combustion (1 min with Kindling) and Meteor (45 sec) with it.
[우선 처치] Kill the Captain first (Topicx). Spend Hot Streak! on Pyroblast into the Captain until it dies, then move to the Guard.
[광역 피해] When a Row Hooligan leaps on you with Cutpurse and applies its bleed (155172 Bleed over 8 sec), recast Blazing Barrier (30 sec) to absorb it. Fire Mage cannot remove Heartstop Poison.
2: [차단] The two Seductive Sayaads' Seduction (3 sec cast, 6 sec disorient) take one kicker each (Topicx). Counterspell (25 sec) your assigned one.
[차단] When the pack pulled around the corner stacks on the tank, stop the other Sayaad's Seduction or a Felonious Mage's Fel Missiles with Supernova (45 sec, 8 yd knock-up).
3: [차단] Counterspell the two Felonious Mages' Fel Missiles channel (Fire every sec for 5 sec) when you have it spare.
[광역 피해] Six Felwyrms and Row Hooligans stack here, so spend Hot Streak! on Flamestrike, and use Combustion too if it is back from pull 1.
5: [우선 처치] Massive Felwyrm comes first (Topicx). Line up Combustion and Meteor on it and spend Hot Streak! on Pyroblast into it. Fire Mage cannot dispel Corroding Spittle (Magic), so ask for a dispel if it hits you.

[회피] When the dying Massive Felwyrm casts Massive Fel Detonation (5 sec cast, 290947 Fire within 10 yd), Shimmer more than 10 yd away. Recast Blazing Barrier when Over-infused's Burning Fel (38793 Fire within 50 yd every 3 sec) stacks up.
8: [차단] Stop the two Fel Invokers' Health Funnel (30 sec channel, heals the target 10% of max health every 2 sec): Counterspell one and Supernova the other.
[차단] Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage (3.5 sec cast, 60% damage reduction and crowd-control immunity for 1 min) is an enrage that Fire Mage cannot remove. Kick it with Counterspell if you have it.

[우선 처치] Below 50%, Shivan Punisher hits the party with Demonic Frenzy (29095 Fire every sec) until it dies (Topicx). Line up Combustion and Meteor as the Punisher drops below 50%, and recast Blazing Barrier when Frenzy starts.
9: [해제] Corrupted Warlock's Curse of Doom (581895 Shadow after 10 sec, split among everyone within 4 yd) is a curse. Remove it right away with Remove Curse (8 sec) (Wowhead rates Remove Curse as Need in this dungeon).
[참고] If you are the Drain Life target, break the channel with Greater Invisibility (2 min, 20 sec invisibility and threat reset). Without a defensive the Warlock heals a lot (Topicx).
[광역 피해] Eight Demon Flies stack here, so spend Hot Streak! on Flamestrike and kick Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage with Counterspell.
10: [차단] The first Health Funnel from the Fel Invokers must be stopped (Topicx). Counterspell one and Supernova the other.
[우선 처치] Line up Combustion and Meteor as Shivan Punisher drops below 50%, and use Flamestrike on the eight Demon Flies. Recast Blazing Barrier when Demonic Frenzy starts.
11: [우선 처치] Kill Felmaster Lucsei before Blade Dance comes out more than three times (Topicx). Line up Combustion and Meteor on Lucsei and spend Hot Streak! on Pyroblast into it.

[광역 피해] Recast Blazing Barrier right before Blade Dance (2 sec cast, 43642 Fire every 0.4 sec for 1.2 sec), and if Blazing Barrier is down for the second Blade Dance, press Ice Block. With Ice Cold it reduces damage taken by 70% for 6 sec.
13: [광역 피해] Recast Blazing Barrier right before Defiled Golem's Defiled Slam (2 sec cast, 145474 Fire to everyone). Shimmer out of Fel Beam (96982 Fire every sec); Shimmer works while casting.
[제어] When the six Unleashed Imps stack on the tank, knock them up with Supernova to stop Felfire Burst (1.5 sec cast), and kill them with the Golem using Combustion and Flamestrike.
[차단] Counterspell one of the two Wrathguard Flayers' Fel Rage.
14: [차단] Kick Fel Invoker's Health Funnel with Counterspell, and stop the six Unleashed Imps' Felfire Burst together with Supernova.
[광역 피해] Imps and Felhunters stack here, so spend Hot Streak! on Flamestrike, and kick Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage when Counterspell is back.
15: [해제] Remove Corrupted Warlock's Curse of Doom right away with Remove Curse. Drain Life overlapping the Punisher's Demonic Frenzy is lethal (Topicx).

[참고] If you are the Drain Life target, break the channel with Greater Invisibility. The tank drags the Warlock back first, so line up Combustion and Meteor on the Warlock and use the next Combustion (1 min) on the Punisher.
[광역 피해] Recast Blazing Barrier when Shivan Punisher drops below 50% and starts Demonic Frenzy.
16: [우선 처치] Stack damage so Defiled Golem's AoE ends within two casts (Topicx). Line up Combustion and Meteor on the Golem and spend Hot Streak! on Pyroblast into it.
[광역 피해] Take the first Defiled Slam with Blazing Barrier and press Ice Block (Ice Cold) for a second Slam that lands before Blazing Barrier is back. Shimmer out of Fel Beam.
[차단] Split the two Fel Invokers' Health Funnel between Counterspell and Supernova.

1: [해제] Starvation Effigy's Insatiable Hunger (15% max health reduction for 25 sec, stacking) is a curse. Clear the most-stacked party members first with Remove Curse (8 sec) (Topicx; Wowhead rates Remove Curse as Need in this dungeon).

[광역 피해] The first lust and cooldowns go on this pull (Topicx). If nobody else has lust, pop Time Warp (5 min) and line up Combustion and Meteor with it. Spend Hot Streak! on Pyroblast into the Starvation Effigy until the totem dies.

[광역 피해] Recast Blazing Barrier (30 sec) right before the Feast of Misery channel (38793 Shadow every sec for 5 sec). If it overlaps with Insatiable Hunger stacks, press Ice Block. With Ice Cold it reduces damage taken by 70% for 6 sec.
2: [차단] Kick Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze (3.5 sec cast, heals nearby allies) and Earth Bolt (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Nature) with Counterspell (25 sec).
[해제] Clear Insatiable Hunger with Remove Curse, and break the Starvation Effigy fast with Fire Blast.
3: [해제] Clear Insatiable Hunger with Remove Curse and spend Hot Streak! on Pyroblast into the Starvation Effigy.
[차단] Kick Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze with Counterspell.
4: [해제] Clear Insatiable Hunger with Remove Curse and recast Blazing Barrier right before Feast of Misery.

[참고] Fire Mage cannot remove the three Keen-Eyed Strikers' Razor Dive bleed (33944 Physical every sec for 10 sec, stacking). When stacks build, absorb them with Blazing Barrier, and if that is not enough, pop Alter Time (1 min) beforehand and press it again to restore your health.
7: [광역 피해] This is the cooldown pull after the boss (Topicx). Line up Combustion and Meteor on the pack gathered in the corner and spend Hot Streak! on Flamestrike.
[차단] Counterspell one of the two Earthwhisper Tenders and stop the other's Healing Breeze next to the tank with Supernova (45 sec, 8 yd knock-up).
8: [광역 피해] Terra Rumbler's Rumbling Ward (24246 Nature to everyone every 2 sec while the shield holds) must break fast, so spend Hot Streak! on Pyroblast into the Rumbler. Recast Blazing Barrier when the damage stacks up.
9: [광역 피해] This is the second lust pull (Topicx). If nobody else has lust, pop Time Warp and line up Combustion and Meteor. Use Pyroblast on the Terra Rumbler shield.
[차단] Stop the two Frigid Maulers' Frigid Roar (3.5 sec cast, 50% haste and movement speed reduction): Counterspell one and Supernova the other.
[광역 피해] Glacial Revenant deals periodic magic damage with no cast bar (Topicx). Recast Blazing Barrier on cooldown while a Revenant is alive.
10: [광역 피해] This is the cooldown pull after lust (Topicx). If Combustion (1 min with Kindling) and Meteor (45 sec) from pull 9 are back, line them up here.
[차단] Split the two Frigid Maulers' Frigid Roar between Counterspell and Supernova. The 3.5 sec cast leaves time to coordinate with the rest of the kick order.
11: [우선 처치] Kill Avatar of Determination first, then Terra Rumbler (Topicx). Line up Combustion and Meteor on the Avatar and spend Hot Streak! on Pyroblast into it.

[회피] Shimmer more than 12 yd away from the Avatar's Pulverize (4 sec cast, 12 yd stun plus 387930 Physical); Shimmer works while casting. Help break party members out of Glacial Tomb (38793 Frost every 2 sec) with Fire Blast.
13: [차단] Stop the two Stormbound Mystics' Arc Lightning (4 sec cast, 193965 Nature to up to 3 targets): Counterspell one and Supernova the other.
[우선 처치] Break Ruthless Totemcaller's Magma Totem (36368 Fire to everyone every 0.3 sec) right away with Fire Blast, which works while casting.
[광역 피해] Recast Blazing Barrier right before Grizzled Warbringer's Primal Echo (60 yd armor-ignoring Physical, stacking).
14: [우선 처치] Break the two Ruthless Totemcallers' Magma Totems one by one with Fire Blast. Kick Stormbound Mystic's Arc Lightning with Counterspell.
[광역 피해] This is a candidate for the third lust (Topicx). Outside high keys you can use Time Warp here, and line up Combustion and Meteor on the Bonded Beasttamer and Loyal Saberfang pack.
[제어] If a Loyal Saberfang enraged by Bestial Wrath fixates and chases you, root it with Frost Nova (30 sec, 6 sec root) and make distance with Shimmer.
15: [광역 피해] This is a big pull at 85 trash. Line up Combustion and Meteor on the four Grizzled Warbringers and spend Hot Streak! on Flamestrike.
[광역 피해] The Warbringers' Primal Echoes come one after another (Topicx). Take the first Echo with Blazing Barrier and any Echo that lands before Blazing Barrier is back with Ice Block (Ice Cold).
[차단] Split the two Stormbound Mystics' Arc Lightning between Counterspell and Supernova, and break Magma Totems with Fire Blast.
16: [차단] Kick Loa Speaker Nanea's Lightning Bolt (2.5 sec cast) with Counterspell.

[우선 처치] The three Volatile Totems must die before the third wave (Topicx). If the totems are close together, break them with Meteor and Flamestrike, and if Nanea is around 10% health, finish her with Pyroblast. In high keys where lust goes here, press Combustion with it.
[회피] If you are targeted by Earthquake, Shimmer out of the party before the zone lands.

1: [차단] The tank takes the first kick on Voidtouched Magi's Shadowbolt Volley (4 sec cast, 193965 Shadow within 60 yd) (Topicx). Kick the second cast with Counterspell (25 sec) and leave the Enthralled Shamans' Lava Bolt to the other kickers.

[광역 피해] This lust pull drags the whole first hallway into the mini-boss (Topicx). If nobody else has lust, pop Time Warp (5 min) and line up Combustion (1 min with Kindling) and Meteor (45 sec) once the Magi is pulled back into the room.
[회피] If you are targeted by Null Eruption (4 sec cast, 145474 Shadow within 10 yd plus 38793 Shadow every sec for 5 sec), Shimmer out of the party and recast Blazing Barrier (30 sec).
2: [우선 처치] Raj'kess the Spellstorm's three Orbs of Disruption must die before any of their casts finish (Topicx). Hit the orbs right away with Fire Blast, which works while casting, and Hot Streak! Pyroblast.

[광역 피해] Recast Blazing Barrier right before the long Thundering Storm party AoE, and if Blazing Barrier is down for the second Storm, press Ice Block. With Ice Cold it reduces damage taken by 70% for 6 sec. Line up Combustion and Meteor on Raj'kess.
3: [제어] You can break Protective Turtle's Shell Guard (75% damage reduction for nearby allies) by turning the turtle into a sheep with Polymorph (Wowhead).

[광역 피해] This is the biggest pull at 158 trash. Line up Combustion and Meteor on the mobs dragged out of Shell Guard and spend Hot Streak! on Flamestrike. When Brutok hits a wall and is stunned for 5 sec by Concussion, pour Pyroblast into it.

[광역 피해] Recast Blazing Barrier right before Chitigoth's Insidious Aura (87284 Nature to everyone every 2 sec for 10 sec). If Angry Krolusk's Violent Sand hits you (155172 Nature to everyone, 40% slow for 12 sec), recast Blazing Barrier to clear the slow with Energized Barriers.
5: [차단] Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek (3.5 sec cast, 6 sec fear within 60 yd) is the most important kick in this area (Topicx). Save Counterspell for the Screamer.
[회피] If you are targeted by Watchful Harrower's Void Beam (43642 Shadow within 8 yd every 0.5 sec for 4 sec), Shimmer out of the party and recast Blazing Barrier.
[광역 피해] Line up Combustion and Meteor on the Harrower (65 count) and spend Hot Streak! on Pyroblast into it.
6: [우선 처치] Brutal Overseer's Brutal Slams shield must be broken fast with damage cooldowns (Topicx). Line up Combustion and Meteor on the shield and spend Hot Streak! on Pyroblast into the Overseer.

[광역 피해] Recast Blazing Barrier as Brutal Slams (48491 Physical to everyone every 1.5 sec, +10% per slam) stacks up, and press Ice Block (Ice Cold) if it overlaps the Watchful Harrower's Sky Strike soak. Shimmer out of Macestorm (8 yd, 6 sec).
[차단] Kick Enthralled Shaman's Lava Bolt (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Fire) with Counterspell.
8: [우선 처치] Kill Devouring Brutalizer's Devour target (9 sec cast, marked mob) with Fire Blast and Hot Streak! Pyroblast before the cast ends. Damage cooldowns go on this pull (Topicx), so press Combustion and Meteor together.

[차단] Kick Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek with Counterspell. Stop the two Voidminders' Mending Void (20 sec healing channel) together with Supernova (45 sec, 8 yd knock-up) when they stack on the tank.
[광역 피해] Recast Blazing Barrier right before Dreadbellow (knockback plus 29095 Shadow every sec for 12 sec, cannot be dispelled).
9: [광역 피해] Ten Scavenging Siphoids stack here, so spend Hot Streak! on Flamestrike, and use Combustion with Meteor if it is back. Kill the Devour target first with Pyroblast.
[차단] Kick Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek with Counterspell, and stop Enthralled Shaman's Lava Bolt and Voidminder's Mending Void together with Supernova.
10: [광역 피해] This last big pull has both a Watchful Harrower and a Devouring Brutalizer. Line up Combustion and Meteor here and kill the Devour target first with Pyroblast.
[광역 피해] If the Dreadbellow DoT and Void Beam overlap, follow Blazing Barrier with Ice Block (Ice Cold). If you are the Void Beam target, Shimmer out of the party.
[차단] Split the two Voidminders' Mending Void between Counterspell and Supernova.

1: [광역 피해] This is the first pull of the dungeon, so use Bloodlust (Topicx). If nobody else has lust, pop Time Warp (5 min) and line up Combustion (1 min with Kindling) and Meteor (45 sec) with it.

[광역 피해] When Shadow-Borne Champion starts Shadow Whirlwind (4 sec cast, 164870 Shadow within 100 yd), refresh Blazing Barrier (30 sec), and on high keys press Ice Block (70% less damage taken for 6 sec with Ice Cold) if Barrier is not back.
[참고] Do not Spellsteal Bound by Shadow from the Minion of Zul on the way. It kills its holder when removed, so the mage who steals it dies (Wowhead).
2: [차단] Put Counterspell (25 sec) in the kick rotation for Risen Hexer's Hex Volley (3.5 sec cast, 116379 Shadow plus a 12 sec curse DoT), and if it lands, remove the curse with Remove Curse (8 sec) (Wowhead).
[광역 피해] The corner pack is a cooldown pull (Topicx). If Combustion and Meteor from pull 1 are back, use them here, and refresh Blazing Barrier right before Shadow Whirlwind.
4: [차단] Put Queen Wasi's Bind Soul (2.5 sec cast, 10 sec charm) and Soul Bolt and Seneschal M'bara's Unholy Mending into the Counterspell rotation.
[참고] When Guard Captain Atu casts Captain's Bulwark (nearby mobs take 30% less damage), steal it off with Spellsteal (21% of base mana) (Wowhead).

[광역 피해] Press Combustion only after the tank has aggro on the pack that wakes up (Topicx). Save Meteor for the hardest pack, King A'akul with the Bloodsworn Assassins, and if Blood Drain (164870 Physical) comes while you carry the Sudden Rupture bleed, refresh Blazing Barrier to absorb it.
5: [광역 피해] Refresh Blazing Barrier right before Purification Construct's Purifying Flame (174568 Fire to the whole group). If you use Bloodlust here on a high key, press Time Warp and Combustion together (Topicx).
[위치] While backpedaling out of the pools, keep up damage with instant Pyroblasts from Hot Streak! and Fire Blast. Sunfury builds can also cast Scorch while moving.
6: [차단] Take one of the two Half-Finished Mummies' Wretched Discharge (4 sec cast, 12 sec disease DoT on the whole group) with Counterspell. If both stand next to the tank, stop them together with Supernova (45 sec).
7: [차단] On the other side, also take one of the two Half-Finished Mummies' Wretched Discharge with Counterspell, and if they stand together, stop both with Supernova.
[광역 피해] Hit the eight Embalming Fluids together with Flamestrike. If a Putrid Seekers pool slows you by 20%, recast Blazing Barrier so Energized Barriers removes the slow.
9: [우선 처치] Spend Hot Streak! on Pyroblast to kill the two Spectral Shamans first, and if a Healing Tide Totem is already down, break it right away with Fire Blast.
[차단] Counterspell one Phantom Hex Priest's Hex (3.5 sec cast, 5 sec polymorph), and when both are stacked on the tank, stop them together with Supernova (Topicx).
[해제] If a Hex (curse) gets through, remove it from the party member at once with Remove Curse (Wowhead).
10: [우선 처치] On a four-Bloodlust route this pull is the third Bloodlust (Topicx). Line up Combustion and Meteor on the Ghostly Brute and melt it first.

[회피] If you are inside Ghostly Brute's Seismic Upheaval (5 sec cast, 387930 Physical nearby), leave with Shimmer (20 yd). Counterspell the remaining Phantom Hex Priest's Hex, and if it lands, clear it with Remove Curse.
12: [회피] If Shadow of Zul's Dark Revelation (473120 Shadow within 20 yd after 5 sec) targets you, clear the debuff with Greater Invisibility (1 min with Master of Escape) (Wowhead). If it is not available, Shimmer more than 20 yd away from the group.
[위치] Ranged DPS soak the far Pool of Darkness (Topicx). If it is yours, Shimmer into it, and do not Spellsteal Bound by Shadow from the summoned Minion of Zul.

1: [차단] The two Flashfrost Chillweavers' Ice Shield (15 sec channel, shields an ally every 3 sec and prevents crowd control) must be stopped, so spend Counterspell (25 sec) on this channel first.

[광역 피해] Once everything up to the entrance is stacked, line up Combustion (1 min with Kindling) and Meteor (45 sec), and spend Hot Streak! on Pyroblast to kill the CC-immune Primal Juggernaut first (Topicx).
[회피] Refresh Blazing Barrier (30 sec) right before Excavating Blast (3.5 sec cast, 106681 Nature within 60 yd plus an 8 sec DoT), and Shimmer out of the falling Blast Chunks circles (6 yd).
2: [차단] Counterspell Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield channel. Primal Juggernaut is immune to crowd control, so hold Supernova.
[위치] Touching the eggs in the water pools spawns Infused Whelps (Topicx), so do not Shimmer toward the pools.
3: [우선 처치] Defier Draghar (30 count) is immune to crowd control, so line up Combustion and Meteor on it, and Counterspell Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield.
[광역 피해] Steel Barrage hits the tank for 3 sec and each strike deals 24246 Fire to party members within 60 yd, so refresh Blazing Barrier when you see the cast.
5: [차단] Put the two Primalist Cinderweavers' Cinderbolt (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Fire) first in the Counterspell rotation (Topicx). If nobody can stop a Cinderbolt aimed at you, dodge it with Greater Invisibility (1 min with Master of Escape) (Wowhead).

[제어] Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage (10 sec channel) cannot be interrupted, so knock it up with Supernova (45 sec) to stop it. When a dying Flamelasher starts Blaze of Glory, remove it with Spellsteal (21% of base mana) (Wowhead).
[광역 피해] Refresh Blazing Barrier right before Blazebound Destroyer's Inferno (group Fire damage plus a 5 sec DoT), and when the Destroyer dies, Shimmer out of the 20 yd Burnout explosion at once.
6: [회피] If Flamegullet's Flame Breath (4 sec cast, 96982 Fire in a frontal cone repeatedly for 3 sec) faces you, leave the cone with Shimmer, which works while casting.

[우선 처치] Below 50%, Flamegullet's (40 count) Molten Blood group damage keeps growing, so line up Combustion and Meteor just before 50% to kill it quickly. On +17 and higher Bloodlust goes at 50%, so pop Time Warp if nobody else has lust (Topicx).
[차단] Counterspell Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt, and stop Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Supernova.
7: [차단] Counterspell the two Primalist Cinderweavers' Cinderbolt and stop Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Supernova. Remove a dying Flamelasher's Blaze of Glory with Spellsteal (Wowhead).

[위치] If Living Bomb targets you, Shimmer more than 6 yd away from the group. If the explosion is about to knock you up, press Alter Time (1 min) beforehand and press it again after the blast to return to the ground and restore your health (Wowhead).
8: [위치] Thunderhead patrols near this pack, so do not Shimmer forward and pull it (Topicx).
[광역 피해] If Combustion is back, line it up on the Blazebound Destroyer pack, and refresh Blazing Barrier right before the Destroyer's Inferno. Remove the Flamelasher's Blaze of Glory with Spellsteal.
10: [광역 피해] Six Storm Warriors stack up, so spend Hot Streak! on Flamestrike and line up Combustion and Meteor on this pull. Refresh Blazing Barrier as Thunderous Stomp (53340 Nature within 60 yd) repeats.
[제어] Stop Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Supernova, and remove its Blaze of Glory on death with Spellsteal (Wowhead).

[광역 피해] If Tempest Channeler's Lightning Torrent (7 sec channel, 65463 Nature every 1 sec) targets you, refresh Blazing Barrier, and if that is not enough, press Ice Block (70% less damage taken for 6 sec with Ice Cold).
11: [차단] Counterspell Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt. This stretch is pulled without stopping (Topicx), so keep damage up while moving with Fire Blast and instant Pyroblasts from Hot Streak!.
[위치] If Living Bomb targets you, Shimmer away from the group, and if Lightning Torrent targets you, refresh Blazing Barrier.
12: [우선 처치] High Channeler Ryvati's Tempest Stormshield (absorbs 20% of max health, 29095 Nature to the party every 1 sec while up) must break before it expires to prevent a 4 sec stun within 60 yd, so line up Combustion and Meteor on the shield (Topicx).
[광역 피해] Refresh Blazing Barrier while the shield is up, and if your team uses Bloodlust on Ryvati on high keys, pop Time Warp when nobody else has lust (Topicx).

1: [차단] Put Counterspell (25 sec) in the kick rotation for the three Storm Adepts' Lightning Bolt (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Nature). A Lightning Bolt that slips through during Sandfury Stonefist's Ground Pound (4 sec cast) kills people, so do not miss kicks then (Topicx).

[제어] When Sandswept Hunter starts Arrow Barrage on you (9 sec channel, repeated Physical hits), break the channel with Greater Invisibility (1 min with Master of Escape) (Wowhead), and knock up Hunters stacked on the tank with Supernova (45 sec).

[광역 피해] This is the first pull, so line up Combustion (1 min with Kindling) and Meteor (45 sec) on the CC-immune Stonefist, and refresh Blazing Barrier (30 sec) right before Ground Pound (156627 Physical within 60 yd, knockback).
2: [위치] The Shrouded Fangs below the stairs are stealthed, so do not drop Flamestrike or Meteor down the stairs before the tank engages first (Topicx).
[차단] Put the two Storm Adepts' Lightning Bolt in the Counterspell rotation, and refresh Blazing Barrier right before Ground Pound.
4: [위치] Sand-Sworn Rider's Swarming Krolusks run at DPS standing far away (Topicx), so stand close to the tank so the adds land in your Flamestrike, and root them for 6 sec with Frost Nova (30 sec, 12 yd) when they reach you.
[차단] Counterspell Storm Adept's Lightning Bolt, and stop Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage with Supernova.
5: [차단] The two Storm Adepts' Lightning Bolt kills whoever is also hit by a Krolusk leap or Cytotoxin (Topicx). Counterspell one, and stop both together with Supernova when they are stacked on the tank.

[광역 피해] Many mobs stack up, so line up Combustion and Meteor and spend Hot Streak! on Flamestrike. Fire Mage cannot remove the Cytotoxin poison, so refresh Blazing Barrier to absorb the DoT if it hits you.
6: [해제] One kicker is enough for Faithless Subjugator's Addle Mind (5 sec cast, 5 sec disorient) (Topicx), so take it with Counterspell, and remove the curse from an affected party member with Remove Curse (8 sec).
[차단] Counterspell the two Brood Tenders' Venom Bolt (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Nature) when it is spare, and stop the remaining cast with Supernova.
7: [차단] Counterspell Brood Tender's Venom Bolt so it does not land on someone carrying the Cytotoxin poison (Topicx). If Faithless Subjugator's Addle Mind lands, remove it with Remove Curse.
[제어] Stop Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage with Supernova, and if it targets you, break the channel with Greater Invisibility (Wowhead).
9: [참고] Steal the two Agitated Nimbuses' Accumulate Charge (8% more damage, 3 stacks) with Spellsteal (21% of base mana). Fewer stacks also weaken Release Charge's group damage (Wowhead).
[광역 피해] Refresh Blazing Barrier right before Release Charge (3 sec cast, 145474 Nature to the whole party), and Counterspell the two Imbued Stormcallers' Lightning Bolt.
[회피] In the Loose Sparks section, do not rush. Dodge the orbs with Shimmer, then kill the Spark Channeler with Pyroblast (Topicx).
10: [차단] Stop the two Imbued Stormcallers before gathering the other mobs (Topicx). Counterspell one, and if they stand together, stop both with Supernova.
[광역 피해] When the four Static Anomalies stack, use Flamestrike and Meteor, steal Agitated Nimbus's Accumulate Charge with Spellsteal, and refresh Blazing Barrier right before Release Charge.
12: [제어] Polymorph the Temple Disruptor on the far side of the orb to stop its Essence Disruption channel (Wowhead). Counterspell the Disruptor on the tank's side.

[광역 피해] Refresh Blazing Barrier right before Orb Watcher's Caustic Stomp (3.5 sec cast, 116379 Nature within 60 yd plus a 10 sec DoT), and hit the Orb Watcher and the gathered Faithless Conscripts together with Flamestrike.
13: [제어] Polymorph the far Temple Disruptor and Counterspell the near one to protect the orb's charge (Wowhead). Once the orb reaches 100%, the Disruptors stop, so finish them then (Topicx).
[광역 피해] Line up Combustion and Meteor on the Orb Watcher, and refresh Blazing Barrier right before Caustic Stomp.
14: [차단] The CC-immune Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock (4 sec cast, 242456 Fire plus an 8 sec DoT) must be stopped, so save Counterspell for this cast.
[제어] Root the four Faithless Tormentors chasing the healer for 6 sec with Frost Nova (12 yd) next to the healer, and kill them together with Flamestrike.
[위치] If Latent Hex targets you, Shimmer more than 10 yd away from the group so Hex Muck does not form on the party.
